lar cloud: sign-in and direct connections

map.destination: Anyone with a lar server signs in on lar.app and streams directly from their server while away, with automatic port mapping. The cloud handles sign-in and server discovery; media goes directly between server and player.
decisions: Owner accounts live in the cloud, not on each server (#203 research).
The cloud handles account and discovery requests; it never carries media (#203).
Sign-in uses passkeys first, email links as fallback.
fog: Which automatic port-mapping methods should be tried, and how should an unavailable direct connection be explained? (#201)
What does the sign-in screen look like on the website and in the apps? (#202)

items.title: Resume playback across devices

map.destination: Stop watching on one device and resume on another at the same second. The server stores each position per device and profile; the Apple apps read it on open.
decisions: Positions are stored per profile, not per device (#181).
Apps poll on foreground; no push for now.
